Container.Name: Vetoarr
Container.Overview: Let people on your Plex server request media removal. Plex authentication, owner approvals and Maintainerr integration. The portal does not directly delete files.
Container.Description: Sign in using Plex to request removal of movies or whole TV shows. Shared users submit requests for owner review, while server-owner requests are approved automatically. Approved media is routed to your Maintainerr collections for scheduled deletion. Requires a Plex server, owner token, Maintainerr collections and an HTTPS reverse proxy for internet-facing installations. WARNING: approved requests can eventually delete media permanently.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Plex Maintainerr media requests removal cleanup Radarr Sonarr

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Unraid host port for the portal's HTTP interface; put behind an HTTPS reverse proxy for external access.

Config.Name: Persistent database
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database and session storage. Back up before updates.

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Generate a unique secret, e.g. openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it private and stable.

Config.Name: PORTAL_HOST
Config.Description: Public hostname without https:// (the configured portal host).

Config.Name: PLEX_URL
Config.Description: Reachable Plex server URL. Container names require a shared Docker network.

Config.Name: PLEX_TOKEN
Config.Description: Private owner Plex token; never publish or share.

Config.Name: MAINTAINERR_URL
Config.Description: Reachable Maintainerr URL. Container names require a shared Docker network.

Config.Name: Movies collection
Config.Description: Maintainerr collection ID for Plex Movies library.

Config.Name: TV collection
Config.Description: Maintainerr collection ID for Plex TV Shows library.

Config.Name: Kids Movies collection
Config.Description: Maintainerr collection ID for Kids Movies.

Config.Name: Anime Movies collection
Config.Description: Maintainerr collection ID for Anime Movies.

Config.Name: Kids TV collection
Config.Description: Maintainerr collection ID for Kids TV Shows.

Config.Name: Anime TV collection
Config.Description: Maintainerr collection ID for Anime TV Shows.

Config.Name: Minimum deletion days
Config.Description: Minimum Maintainerr deletion delay allowed by the portal.

Config.Name: Database file
Config.Description: SQLite file inside the persistent /data mount.

Config.Name: Plex SSO client ID
Config.Description: Stable Plex PIN client identifier; keep unchanged after first deployment.
